full_details: In the morning the fourth sheet was fit to carry, with Mowbray's line and no name under it. You played Egeon again. At the end of the play Raye said the Wise Man is wizard's disguises and Welsh jokes and holds two thousand in its hand, and you called that a house. At the lodging you tied the four sheets. At the Jackdaw there were fish and eggs at sixpence each. Burbage laughed when the ten years became six, said the king does it because he can, and took the long speech rather than hear it read. Agnes stopped with the jug. He asked who would play the other man. You said you would not name him tonight. The slate was two sixpences. At home you kept the same refusal and did not add another.
one_sentence: You carried four sheets to the Jackdaw, Burbage read the long speech to the fire, and you ate the eggs cold.
title: Burbage took the speech at the Jackdaw
